inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Willingness and ability to undergo a baseline tumour biopsy

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Willingness and ability to provide blood samples at pre‑specified time points

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Willingness and ability to undergo baseline FDG‑PET/CT

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: ECOG performance status ≤ 1.

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Histologically or cytologically confirmed progressive advanced/metastatic HER2‑positive breast carcinoma according to ASCO‑CAP guidelines, with HER2 status determined on the primary tumor or, if unavailable, on a metastatic lesion.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Multifocal unilateral or bilateral breast adenocarcinoma tumors are allowed if all tested lesions are HER2‑positive according to local testing.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Multifocal unilateral or bilateral breast adenocarcinoma tumors are allowed if all tested lesions are HER2‑positive according to local testing.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Prior treatment with a taxane, trastuzumab and pertuzumab (early or advanced setting).
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Prior treatment with a taxane, trastuzumab and pertuzumab (early or advanced setting).

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Must have received trastuzumab‑deruxtecan (T‑DXd) as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and have disease progression on T‑DXd.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Must have received trastuzumab‑deruxtecan (T‑DXd) as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and have disease progression on T‑DXd.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Prior therapy with tucatinib, trastuzumab, and capecitabine in the advanced setting is permissible provided that T‑DXd serves as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and the patient has disease progression on T‑DXd.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Prior therapy with tucatinib, trastuzumab, and capecitabine in the advanced setting is permissible provided that T‑DXd serves as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and the patient has disease progression on T‑DXd.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Life expectancy ≥ 6 months.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Life expectancy ≥ 6 months.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: At screening FDG‑PET, at least two target lesions are required.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: At screening FDG‑PET, at least two target lesions are required.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Each target lesion must have an anatomic transaxial diameter ≥ 1.5 cm.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Each target lesion must have an anatomic transaxial diameter ≥ 1.5 cm.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Each target lesion must be metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Each target lesion must be metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Lesions are required to fulfil the following criteria: anatomically transaxial diameter ≤ 1.5 cm
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Lesions are required to fulfil the following criteria: anatomically transaxial diameter ≤ 1.5 cm

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Lesions are required to fulfil the following criteria: metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean body mass (SUVmax) ≤ 1.5 x SUVmean + 2 standard deviations (SD) of the liver measured in a 3‑cm‑diameter spherical volume of interest (VOI) in normal liver parenchyma
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Lesions are required to fulfil the following criteria: metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean body mass (SUVmax) ≤ 1.5 x SUVmean + 2 standard deviations (SD) of the liver measured in a 3‑cm‑diameter spherical volume of interest (VOI) in normal liver parenchyma

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: In case of suspected liver metastasis, a lesion should have a SUVmax ≤ 2 x SUVmean + 3 SD of the blood pool measured in a 1 cm‑diameter VOI within descending thoracic aorta
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: In case of suspected liver metastasis, a lesion should have a SUVmax ≤ 2 x SUVmean + 3 SD of the blood pool measured in a 1 cm‑diameter VOI within descending thoracic aorta

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC) ≥ 1000/µL or ≥ 1×10^9/L

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Platelets ≥ 100,000/µL or ≥ 100×10^9/L
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Platelets ≥ 100,000/µL or ≥ 100×10^9/L

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Haemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN)

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Estimated creatinine clearance ≥ 60 ml/min as calculated using the method standard for the institution

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Total serum bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN unless the patient subject has documented Gilbert syndrome
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Total serum bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN unless the patient subject has documented Gilbert syndrome

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Aspartate and Alanine Aminotransferase (AST and ALT) ≤ 2.5 × ULN

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Current left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥ 50% on echocardiography or multiple‑gated acquisition scanning

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: No history of a LVEF < 40% or symptomatic heart failure or a recent myocardial infarction

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Willingness to provide tumour tissue (mandatory biopsy) and blood samples (mandatory) for translational research activities

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Affiliated to the French Social Security System (inclusion criterion applicable to FRANCE only)

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: HER2‑positive metastatic breast cancer (mBC) after at least one line of systemic therapy for advanced disease.
